title: Jean — insulin co-pay (Haitian Creole, Venmo)

voice.instructions: A Haitian man in his fifties speaking Haitian Creole, steady and polite, moderate pace.

transcript: Bonjou. Mwen rele Jean. Mwen gen dyabèt, epi mwen bezwen peye kopeman pou ensilin mwen nan famasi a jodi a. Yo mande m 60 dola, e mwen pa genyen l. Se mwen ak madanm mwen ki rete lakay la. Venmo mwen se arobaz jean tire baptiste tire h. Mèsi anpil.
englishText: Hello. My name is Jean. I have diabetes, and I need to pay the co-pay for my insulin at the pharmacy today. They're asking me for 60 dollars, and I don't have it. It's my wife and me living at home. My Venmo is at jean dash baptiste dash h. Thank you very much.

extraction.summaryEn: Has diabetes; needs help with a $60 insulin co-pay at the pharmacy today. Household of 2.
extraction.summaryNative: Ou bezwen èd pou peye kopeman ensilin ou nan famasi a jodi a: 60 dola. Se de moun lakay ou.

expected.readBack: Men sa nou konprann. Tanpri di nou si se sa: Ou bezwen èd pou peye kopeman ensilin ou nan famasi a jodi a: 60 dola. Se de moun lakay ou. Si yo apwouve l, lajan an ap ale sou Venmo ou: @jean-baptiste-h.

notifications.text: Bon nouvèl: yo apwouve demann ou an. N ap voye $60 sou Venmo ou kounye a.
Nou voye $60 sou Venmo ou. Nou espere sa ap ede w. Pran swen tèt ou.
